features.name: Knife-sized variant of the powered vibrating serrated-blade family.
Retain serrations in the detailed appearance reference; tiny serration cuts are smoothed from clay under the current authoring rule.
Battery-powered mechanism with removable/rechargeable battery; source does not specify battery-port or control placement.
Activation can be manual or triggered by gripping the handle; audible operation does not require a visible glow.
